title: Publicly funded R&D networks, knowledge spillovers and innovation performance: Evidence from Norway
title_primary: Publicly funded R&D networks, knowledge spillovers and innovation performance: Evidence from Norway
authors: Fulvio Castellacci, Arvid Raknerud, Massimo Riccaboni, Marina Rybalka
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many countries provide public policy support for R&D networks. In publicly funded R&D consortia, firms collaborate with each other and with public scientific institutions to carry out joint innovation projects. The idea behind these policy schemes is that collaborative innovation enables firms to benefit from knowledge spillovers within R&D networks. Surprisingly, however, there is no empirical research showing that spillover effects actually exist in publicly funded R&D consortia. This paper seeks to investigate the extent and sources of knowledge spillovers in R&D networks and to distinguish them from other drivers of additionality generated by collaborative innovation policy programs. Our empirical analysis focuses on Norway and encompasses the entire population of firms supported by R&D policy programs over the period 2002–2022, comprising approximately 15500 collaborative projects. Based on the information on each project, we construct networks of innovators and new R&D spillover pool variables. We use a spatial autoregressive econometric approach and estimate a network regression estimator that endogenizes peer effects related to knowledge spillovers. The econometric results show that the knowledge spillovers arising from publicly funded R&D networks are positive. We also find that the spillover effects resulting from Research Council programs are much stronger than those of tax incentives, and that the spillover effects are much stronger for collaborations between firms operating in different industries than for within-industry collaborations.

title: An Alternative Trade Agreement Design for Global Value Chain Integration
title_zh: 全球价值链整合的替代性贸易协定设计
title_primary: 全球价值链整合的替代性贸易协定设计
title_secondary: An Alternative Trade Agreement Design for Global Value Chain Integration
authors: Himanshu Jaiswal, A. Ganesh‐Kumar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The import tariff system has made a harmful dent in the global trading system. To avoid this, many countries have chosen the second‐best option: a Free Trade Agreement (FTA). The first‐best, devoid of any tariff barriers in the global trading system, is close to impossible to achieve. FTAs, due to their structural factors like stringent Rules of Origin and other non‐tariff measures, have not been very successful for several countries. Additionally, they have been discriminatory to non‐contracting parties. Despite having the potential to establish and strengthen the Global value chains, FTAs have done a dismal work in this dimension, too. To overcome this limitation, we propose in this article a new mechanism called ‘Sectoral Trade Agreement (STA)’, which is an FTA among all major producing countries in a particular sector or industry. In this article, an STA in the automobile sector has been compared with the traditional bilateral FTA with different utilization rates. In our CGE‐based study, welfare as a total rises in STA compared to FTA scenarios. Welfare increases also for some non‐participating blocks. Further, it is shown here how a composite scenario where both FTA and STA are functioning is a better option for trade liberalization and how this could be a new ‘second‐best’.

title: Does logistics service standardization matter for corporate excessive financialization? Evidence from a natural experiment in China
title_zh: 物流服务标准化是否影响企业过度金融化？来自中国自然实验的证据
title_primary: 物流服务标准化是否影响企业过度金融化？来自中国自然实验的证据
title_secondary: Does logistics service standardization matter for corporate excessive financialization? Evidence from a natural experiment in China
authors: Chao Hu, Zhaohui Zhu, Yicheng Chen, Yang Huang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The low efficiency and high costs of logistics depress the return on real-sector investment, leading many firms to reallocate capital towards financial assets. Using the national logistics service standardization (LSS) pilot as a quasi-natural experiment, we find that the LSS pilot significantly inhibits corporate excessive financialization. Mechanism analysis indicates that LSS pilot mitigates corporate excessive financialization by reducing internal management costs and external transaction costs, as well as enhancing production and sales efficiency. Cross-sectional tests further reveal that this effect is more pronounced for firms with higher levels of corporate digitalization, as well as for those located in regions with well-established transportation infrastructure, and greater marketization level. Overall, we highlight the positive impact of LSS pilot and provide a potential solution for promoting the development of the real economy. KEYWORDS: Logistics service standardization corporate excessive financialization development of the real economy cost reduction efficiency improvement JEL CLASSIFICATION: D21 G31 M29
abstract_zh: 物流的低效率和高成本压低了实体部门投资的回报率，导致许多企业将资本重新配置到金融资产上。以全国物流服务标准化试点作为准自然实验，我们发现该试点显著抑制了企业的过度金融化。机制分析表明，物流服务标准化试点通过降低内部管理成本和外部交易成本，以及提升生产和销售效率，缓解了企业的过度金融化。横截面测试进一步揭示，这一效应在企业数字化水平较高、所在地区交通基础设施完善以及市场化程度较高的企业中更为显著。总体而言，我们强调了物流服务标准化试点的积极影响，并为促进实体经济发展提供了潜在解决方案。关键词：物流服务标准化；企业过度金融化；实体经济发展；成本降低；效率提升 JEL分类：D21 G31 M29

title: Climate Change and Long-Run Discount Rates: Evidence from Real Estate
title_zh: 气候变化与长期贴现率：来自房地产的证据
title_primary: 气候变化与长期贴现率：来自房地产的证据
title_secondary: Climate Change and Long-Run Discount Rates: Evidence from Real Estate
authors: Stefano Giglio, Matteo Maggiori, Johannes Ströbel, Andreas Weber
official: 官方在线 2015-11-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The optimal investment to mitigate climate change crucially depends on the discount rate used to evaluate the investment?s uncertain future benefits. The appropriate discount rate is a function of the horizon over which these benefits accrue and the riskiness of the investment. In this paper, we estimate the term structure of discount rates for an important risky asset class, real estate, up to the very long horizons relevant for investments in climate change abatement. We show that this term structure is steeply downward-sloping, reaching 2.6% at horizons beyond 100 years. We explore the implications of these new data within both a general asset pricing framework that decomposes risks and returns by horizon and a structural model calibrated to match a variety of asset classes. Our analysis demonstrates that applying average rates of return that are observed for traded assets to investments in climate change abatement is misleading. We also show that the discount rates for investments in climate change abatement that reduce aggregate risk, as in disaster-risk models, are bounded above by our estimated term structure for risky housing, and should be below 2.6% for long-run benefits. This upper bound rules out many discount rates suggested in the literature and used by policymakers. Our framework also distinguishes between the various mechanisms the environmental literature has proposed for generating downward-sloping discount rates.
abstract_zh: 减缓气候变化的最优投资，关键取决于用于评估投资不确定未来收益的折现率。合适的折现率是这些收益累积的时间跨度及投资风险性的函数。本文中，我们估算了重要风险资产类别——房地产——直至与气候变化减缓投资相关的极长周期内的折现率期限结构。我们证明，这一期限结构呈陡峭下行趋势，在超过100年的周期上降至2.6%。我们分别在按周期分解风险与收益的一般资产定价框架内，以及校准以匹配多种资产类别的结构模型中，探讨了这些新数据的含义。我们的分析表明，将交易资产观察到的平均回报率应用于气候变化减缓投资是具有误导性的。我们还证明，在灾害风险模型中，用于减少总体风险的气候变化减缓投资的折现率，其上限受我们估算的风险住房期限结构约束，长期收益应低于2.6%。这一上限排除了文献中及政策制定者使用的许多折现率建议。我们的框架还区分了环境文献中提出的产生下行折现率期限结构的各种机制。

title: Globalization, Structural Change and International Comovement
title_zh: 全球化、结构变迁与国际经济联动
title_primary: 全球化、结构变迁与国际经济联动
title_secondary: Globalization, Structural Change and International Comovement
authors: Barthelemy Bonadio, Zhen Huo, Andrei Levchenko, Nitya Pandalai-Nayar
official: 官方在线 2023-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the roles of globalization and structural change in the evolution of international GDP comovement among industrialized countries over the period 1978-2007. In recent decades, trade integration between advanced economies increased rapidly while average GDP correlations remained stable. We show that structural change – trend reallocation of economic activity towards services – plays an important part in resolving this apparent puzzle. Business cycle shocks in the service sector are less internationally correlated than in manufacturing, and thus structural change lowers GDP comovement by increasing the share of less correlated sectors in GDP. Globalization – trend reductions in trade costs – exerts two opposing effects on cross-border GDP comovement. On the one hand, greater trade linkages increase international transmission of shocks and therefore comovement. On the other, globalization induces structural change towards services because it reduces the relative price of traded goods, and services and goods are complements. We use a multi-country, multi-sector model of international production and trade to quantify these effects. The two opposing effects of globalization on comovement largely cancel each other out, limiting the net contribution of globalization to increasing international comovement over this period.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了1978年至2007年间全球化与结构性变化在工业化国家国际GDP联动性演变中的作用。近几十年来，发达经济体之间的贸易一体化迅速加深，而平均GDP相关性却保持稳定。我们表明，结构性变化——经济活动向服务业趋势性再配置——在解释这一表面上的悖论中扮演了重要角色。服务业中的商业周期冲击在国际间的相关性低于制造业，因此，结构性变化通过提高GDP中相关性较低部门的份额，降低了GDP联动性。全球化——贸易成本的趋势性降低——对跨境GDP联动性产生两种相反的影响。一方面，更强的贸易联系增强了冲击的国际传导，从而提高了联动性。另一方面，全球化通过降低贸易商品的相对价格，且服务与商品为互补品，促使经济结构向服务业转变。我们运用一个多国、多部门国际生产与贸易模型来量化这些效应。全球化对联动性的两种相反影响在很大程度上相互抵消，限制了全球化在该时期对提升国际联动性的净贡献。

title: International knowledge diffusion and productivity growth in a cash‐in‐advance economy
title_zh: 国际知识扩散与现金先行经济中的生产率增长
title_primary: 国际知识扩散与现金先行经济中的生产率增长
title_secondary: International knowledge diffusion and productivity growth in a cash‐in‐advance economy
authors: Colin Davis, Ken‐ichi Hashimoto
official: 官方在线 2026-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how cash‐in‐advance (CIA) constraints on firm's production and innovation decisions affect the long‐run relationship between monetary policy and innovation‐based economic growth in an open economy. Firms produce differentiated goods and invest in process innovation to reduce production costs. With imperfect knowledge diffusion across countries, the country with the greater share of industry has relatively productive firms. When innovation has a stricter CIA requirement than production, higher nominal interest rates in the country with the larger (smaller) industrial share reduce (increase) productivity growth. We also examine how improved knowledge diffusion affects optimal nominal interest rate policy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在开放经济中，企业生产与创新决策面临的现金预付（CIA）约束如何影响货币政策与基于创新的经济增长之间的长期关系。企业生产差异化产品，并投资于流程创新以降低生产成本。由于知识跨国传播的不完全性，产业份额较大的国家拥有相对更具生产力的企业。当创新比生产面临更严格的现金预付要求时，产业份额较大（较小）的国家提高名义利率会降低（提升）生产率增长。我们还考察了知识传播改善如何影响最优名义利率政策。

title: Don’t Build a Better Fax Machine: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”

title_primary: 不要造更好的传真机：对“以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量”的评论
title_secondary: Don’t Build a Better Fax Machine: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
authors: Christian Terwiesch
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being proposed as a tool to improve the efficiency of academic peer review. While such applications may alleviate reviewer shortages and enhance productivity, they largely preserve the existing architecture of scientific publishing. In this commentary I propose that AI also creates an opportunity to reimagine more fundamental aspects of how knowledge is evaluated and disseminated. Drawing on concepts from operations management and innovation, I propose disruptive alternatives that challenge the underlying design of the current process. Rather than simply helping referees review papers faster, AI may enable new models of scientific communication that are more open, timely, and adaptive to the needs of modern scholarship. This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.
abstract_zh: 人工智能正日益被提出作为提升学术同行评审效率的工具。尽管此类应用可能缓解审稿人短缺问题并提高生产力，但它们大体上保留了科学出版现有的架构。在这篇评论中，我提出人工智能也创造了机会，重新构想知识评估与传播中更为根本的方面。借鉴运营管理与创新的概念，我提出了颠覆性的替代方案，挑战当前流程的基本设计。与其仅仅帮助审稿人更快地审阅论文，人工智能或许能促成新的科学交流模式，这些模式更加开放、及时，并能适应现代学术的需求。本评论由克里斯托夫·洛赫接受发表。

title: Engagement maximization
title_zh: 参与度最大化
title_primary: 参与度最大化
title_secondary: Engagement maximization
authors: Benjamin Hébert, Weijie Zhong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the management of information provision to maximize user engagement. A principal sequentially reveals signals to an agent who has a limited amount of information processing capacity and can choose to exit at any time. We identify a “dilution” strategy—sending rare but highly informative signals—that maximizes user engagement. The platform's engagement metric shapes the direction and magnitude of biases in provided information relative to a user‐optimal benchmark. Even without intertemporal commitment, the platform replicates full‐commitment revenue by inducing the user's belief to remain “as uncertain as” the prior until the rare, decisive signal arrives and induces stopping. We apply our results to two contexts: an ad‐supported internet media platform and a teacher attempting to engage test‐motivated students.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了如何管理信息提供以最大化用户参与度。一位委托人向具有有限信息处理能力且可随时选择退出的代理人顺序揭示信号。我们识别出一种“稀释”策略——发送罕见但信息量大的信号——以最大化用户参与度。平台的参与度指标决定了所提供信息相对于用户最优基准的偏差方向与幅度。即使缺乏跨期承诺能力，平台也能通过使用户信念保持“与先验一样不确定”，直到罕见的关键信号出现并引发停止行为，从而复制完全承诺下的收益。我们将研究结果应用于两个场景：广告支持的互联网媒体平台，以及试图吸引考试驱动型学生的教师。

title: Comparative Cantillon effects in the Canadian and Australian art markets
title_zh: 加拿大与澳大利亚艺术市场的比较康替龙效应
title_primary: 加拿大与澳大利亚艺术市场的比较康替龙效应
title_secondary: Comparative Cantillon effects in the Canadian and Australian art markets
authors: Douglas J. Hodgson, Cameron M. Weber, Bronwyn Coate
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As far back as 1755, Richard Cantillon analyzed how changes in the money supply affected relative prices in the economy. In times of monetary infusion, prices of certain types of goods and services could be expected to rise, depending upon the initial distribution of the money and therefore initial spending. Cantillon emphasized the case of new money falling into the hands of wealthy agents, driving up spending on luxuries, such as artworks (as well as financial assets), and causing their relative prices to increase. We present new evidence on the “Cantillon effect” as a potential explanation for movements in the prices of Canadian and Australian paintings since the mid‐1970s. We econometrically analyze the relationship between time series of the money supply and art prices in each country. Both countries represent peripheral art markets dominated by domestic private and corporate collectors, and they should thus be more responsive to domestic rather than international economic and monetary conditions. For both markets, we distinguish and separately analyze different tiers of the market, separating the very top from a lower segment. We find that prices for top Canadian artists follow the money supply relatively well over the long term, with a similar but slightly weaker result for the top Australian segment; notably, Australian middlebrow prices move more in line with the Consumer Price Index. These results suggest that national art markets are not homogeneous and that segmenting them for analytical purposes may be useful. Specifically, we find stronger evidence of a Cantillon effect in the upper end of the market, while prices of lower‐prestige paintings move more in line with consumer goods prices.
abstract_zh: 早在1755年，理查德·坎蒂隆就分析了货币供给变化如何影响经济中的相对价格。在货币注入时期，某些商品和服务的价格预计会上涨，具体取决于货币的初始分配及由此产生的初始支出。坎蒂隆强调，当新增货币落入富裕阶层手中时，会推高奢侈品（如艺术品及金融资产）的支出，导致其相对价格上升。我们提供了关于“坎蒂隆效应”的新证据，将其作为自20世纪70年代中期以来加拿大和澳大利亚绘画价格变动的潜在解释。我们运用计量经济学方法，分析了各国货币供给时间序列与艺术品价格之间的关系。这两个国家均属于由国内私人及企业收藏家主导的边缘艺术市场，因此它们对国内而非国际经济与货币状况的反应更为敏感。针对这两个市场，我们区分并分别分析了不同市场层级，将顶级市场与较低层级市场分开。研究发现，长期来看，加拿大顶级艺术家的价格与货币供给的走势相对吻合，澳大利亚顶级市场的结果类似但略弱；值得注意的是，澳大利亚中端市场价格与消费者价格指数的变动更为一致。这些结果表明，国家艺术市场并非同质化，按分析目的对其进行分层可能具有价值。具体而言，我们在市场高端发现了更强的坎蒂隆效应证据，而低声望画作的价格则更贴近消费品价格的变动。

title: Climate and Prehistoric Migration
title_zh: 气候与史前迁徙
title_primary: 气候与史前迁徙
title_secondary: Climate and Prehistoric Migration
authors: Peter Huybers, Marco Tabellini, Charles A. Taylor, Francesco Toti
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What factors drove human migration before modern states, markets, and borders? We develop a sorting framework in which climate-specific subsistence knowledge depreciates with ecological distance. To test this, we use ancient DNA identity-by-descent segments to construct bilateral migration flows across Western Eurasia over the last 10,000 years. We document three main findings. First, migration flows decline with differences in growing degree days, precipitation, and soil characteristics between origins and destinations. Second, the binding factor varies across subsistence systems: farmers exhibit strong thermal and soil matching, while pastoralists match most strongly on precipitation. Third, periods of warming increase farmer expansion while cooling increases pastoral expansion in patterns that recover known archaeological migration episodes. Migration also acts as a margin of climate adaptation: populations exposed to temperature change move to destinations that partly offset the shift.
abstract_zh: 在现代国家、市场和边界形成之前，哪些因素驱动了人类迁徙？我们构建了一个分类框架，其中特定气候的生存知识会随生态距离的增加而贬值。为验证这一理论，我们利用古DNA中的同源片段数据，构建了过去一万年间欧亚大陆西部的双边迁徙流。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，迁徙流随原住地与目的地之间生长度日、降水量及土壤特征差异的扩大而递减；第二，不同生计系统中的约束因素存在差异——农耕者表现出强烈的热量与土壤匹配性，而游牧者则对降水量匹配最为显著；第三，气候变暖时期促进农耕者扩张，而气候变冷时期则推动游牧者扩张，其模式与已知考古迁徙事件相吻合。迁徙同时构成气候适应的调节机制：经历温度变化的人口会迁往能部分抵消气候偏移的目的地。

title: The Central Bank’s Dilemma: Look Through Supply Shocks or Control Inflation Expectations?
title_zh: 央行的两难困境：忽视供给冲击还是控制通胀预期？
title_primary: 央行的两难困境：忽视供给冲击还是控制通胀预期？
title_secondary: The Central Bank’s Dilemma: Look Through Supply Shocks or Control Inflation Expectations?
authors: Paul Beaudry & Thomas J Carter & Amartya Lahiri
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When countries are hit by supply shocks, central banks often face the dilemma of either looking through such shocks or reacting to them to ensure that inflation expectations remain anchored. In this paper, we propose a tractable framework to capture this dilemma and explore optimal policy under various assumptions on how agents form their expectations and the sophistication with which those expectations account for the central bank’s announced policies. While our analysis covers a wide range of potential specifications, our baseline results focus on level-k thinking (LKT) – a form of bounded rationality that enjoys significant support in the experimental literature and encompasses both adaptive expectations (AE) and rational expectations (RE) as special cases. Nonetheless, we show that the optimal policy under LKT is qualitatively very different from its analogues under AE and RE, exhibiting abrupt pivots in the policy stance. In particular, it is optimal for the central bank to initially look through supply shocks until a threshold is reached, then pivot discontinuously to a more hawkish anti-inflationary stance. We find that such pivots can, if optimally executed, be compatible with soft landings in the sense that most (or even all) of the reduction in inflation occurs through re-anchoring of expectations rather than economic slack. We also discuss risks and why policy errors in terms of tightening too late or too slowly can be especially costly in such an environment.
abstract_zh: 当各国遭遇供给冲击时，央行常面临两难抉择：是选择忽略此类冲击，还是主动应对以锚定通胀预期。本文构建了一个易于处理的框架来刻画这一困境，并探讨在关于经济主体预期形成方式及其对央行政策声明理解深度的不同假设下，最优政策选择。尽管我们的分析涵盖多种潜在设定，但基准结果聚焦于层级思维（LKT）——这种有限理性形式在实验文献中获得广泛支持，并将适应性预期（AE）和理性预期（RE）作为其特例。然而研究表明，LKT下的最优政策与AE和RE下的对应政策存在本质差异，表现为政策立场的突变式转向。具体而言，央行最优策略是：在供给冲击初期选择忽略，直至达到某个阈值后，突然转向更鹰派的抗通胀立场。我们发现，若此类转向得以最优执行，可兼容经济软着陆——即通胀下降主要源于预期重新锚定而非经济疲软。本文还讨论了相关风险，并指出在此环境下，过迟或过慢收紧的政策失误将付出尤为高昂的代价。

title: Loose bricks in the wall: Underground press and political opposition in non-democracies
title_zh: 墙上的松动砖块：非民主国家的地下媒体与政治反对
title_primary: 墙上的松动砖块：非民主国家的地下媒体与政治反对
title_secondary: Loose bricks in the wall: Underground press and political opposition in non-democracies
authors: Olga Tcaci
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study utilizes locations of underground publications, known as samizdat , to analyze the impact of access to political knowledge on shaping institutional change in the German Democratic Republic during 1989–1990. Survival analysis reveals that regions with greater underground press activity were significantly more likely to experience protests following the fall of the Berlin Wall on November 9, 1989. This delay can be attributed to the increased repression of dissent. However, support for regime change did not necessarily translate into support for rapid German reunification, as evidenced by the voting results of the 1990 democratic elections. Although samizdat did not appear to coordinate the initial protests, it played an informational role in shaping preferences toward gradual institutional change. Finally, in addition to its information function, underground press activities were instrumental in forming opposition that challenged the non-democratic regime, thereby determining the onset of democratization.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用地下出版物（即“萨米兹达特”）的地点分布，分析政治知识获取对1989–1990年德意志民主共和国制度变革的影响。生存分析显示，在1989年11月9日柏林墙倒塌后，地下出版活动更为活跃的地区更有可能发生抗议活动。这一延迟可归因于对异见行为加强的压制。然而，对政权更迭的支持并不必然转化为对快速德国统一的支持，1990年民主选举的投票结果即为明证。尽管萨米兹达特似乎并未协调最初的抗议活动，但它在塑造偏好渐进式制度变革方面发挥了信息作用。最后，除信息功能外，地下出版活动在形成挑战非民主政权的反对派方面也至关重要，从而决定了民主化的启动。

title: The mobilization curse? How oil wealth affects the composition of resistance episodes
title_zh: 动员的诅咒？石油财富如何影响抵抗事件的构成
title_primary: 动员的诅咒？石油财富如何影响抵抗事件的构成
title_secondary: The mobilization curse? How oil wealth affects the composition of resistance episodes
authors: Thea Johansen, Charles Butcher
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How does oil shape anti-state dissent? While previous research suggests that oil wealthy countries may be less likely to democratize and more likely to experience civil wars, few studies have examined how oil wealth shapes the broader composition of anti-state resistance, from political parties, to trade unions, and CSOs. We argue that high levels of oil wealth lower the probability that economically based organizations (such as trade unions) and civil society organizations participate in anti-state dissent by eroding the supply of these organizations and enabling selective cooptation and repression. However, we also argue that oil wealth does not impact political parties, armed rebel groups, and what we label “protest organizations” in the same way, leading to dissent that is more concentrated around organizations designed to capture state power. Using data on the organizational composition of resistance campaigns in Africa from 1990-2015, our findings suggest that high levels of oil wealth reduce the probability of observing economic organizations and CSOs among dissenting organizations and the probability that organizations in general mobilize from economic sectors. Mechanism tests suggest that oil limits the participation of economic organizations in dissent by shrinking or impeding the development of a strong manufacturing sector.
abstract_zh: 石油如何影响反政府抗议？尽管先前的研究表明，石油资源丰富的国家可能更不易民主化，且更易发生内战，但很少有研究探讨石油财富如何塑造反政府抵抗的更广泛构成，包括政党、工会和公民社会组织。我们认为，高水平的石油财富通过削弱这些组织的供给并促成选择性合作与镇压，降低了经济型组织（如工会）和公民社会组织参与反政府抗议的可能性。然而，我们也认为，石油财富对政党、武装反叛团体以及我们称之为“抗议组织”的影响方式不同，导致抗议活动更集中于旨在夺取国家权力的组织。利用1990年至2015年间非洲抵抗运动组织构成的数据，我们的研究结果表明，高水平的石油财富降低了经济组织和公民社会组织出现在抗议组织中的概率，也降低了组织普遍从经济部门动员的可能性。机制测试表明，石油通过缩减或阻碍强大制造业部门的发展，限制了经济组织参与抗议活动。

title: Working From Home and Wage Dynamics
title_zh: 居家办公与工资动态
title_primary: 居家办公与工资动态
title_secondary: Working From Home and Wage Dynamics
authors: Gonzalo Castex, Evgenia Dechter, David Cesarini, Erik Lindqvist, Robert Östling 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how working from home (WFH) relates to wages and wage growth. We propose a labor supply framework with WFH and on-site work modes, and an empirical strategy linking work arrangements to wages and wage growth while addressing selection into WFH. We find no statistically significant relationship between WFH and contemporaneous wages. Men with higher WFH intensity experience slower wage growth; estimates for women are not distinguishable from zero. These patterns are unlikely to be explained by occupational composition or selection. The findings are consistent with WFH affecting human capital accumulation inputs, while having limited implications for contemporaneous productivity.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了居家办公（WFH）与工资及工资增长之间的关系。我们构建了一个包含居家办公和现场办公两种工作模式的劳动力供给框架，并提出了一种实证策略，用以关联工作安排与工资及工资增长，同时处理选择进入居家办公的内生性问题。研究发现，居家办公与当期工资之间不存在统计上显著的关系。对于居家办公强度较高的男性，其工资增长速度较慢；而女性的估计结果则与零无显著差异。这些模式不太可能由职业构成或选择性解释。研究结果与居家办公影响人力资本积累要素、但对当期生产率影响有限的看法相一致。

title: Information design with endogenous state verification
title_zh: 内生状态验证下的信息设计
title_primary: 内生状态验证下的信息设计
title_secondary: Information design with endogenous state verification
authors: Lily Ling Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study a persuasion problem in which the receiver has the ability to probabilistically verify the state at a cost. The sender wants to convince the receiver to accept a project, but the receiver is only willing to accept the project when its quality is above a threshold. The optimal disclosure policy strikes a balance between influencing the receiver’s decisions to accept and to verify the quality. It is deterministic and involves at most three messages, each consisting of an acceptance recommendation and a verification recommendation. Under the optimal disclosure policy, the acceptance recommendation exhibits a cutoff structure, while the verification recommendation exhibits a negative assortative structure. Specifically, the optimal disclosure policy recommends acceptance when the quality exceeds a certain threshold. When the quality falls below this threshold, rejection without verification is recommended. For qualities above the threshold, verification is not recommended if the quality lies within the middle range of the interval. Using the characterization of the optimal disclosure policy, we conduct comparative statics and show that verification is recommended when the probability of successful verification is moderate.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个说服问题，其中接收方有能力以一定成本对状态进行概率性验证。发送方希望说服接收方接受一个项目，但接收方仅在项目质量高于某一阈值时才愿意接受。最优披露策略在影响接收方接受决策与验证质量决策之间取得平衡。该策略是确定性的，并涉及至多三条信息，每条信息包含一个接受建议和一个验证建议。在最优披露策略下，接受建议呈现截断结构，而验证建议呈现负匹配结构。具体而言，最优披露策略在质量超过某一阈值时建议接受。当质量低于此阈值时，建议不验证即拒绝。对于高于阈值的质量，若质量位于区间中间范围，则不建议验证。利用最优披露策略的特征化，我们进行了比较静态分析，并表明当验证成功的概率适中时，会建议进行验证。

title: A Small Act Towards Circular Bioeconomy: Adoption of Integrated Crop‐Livestock System and Its Impacts on Fertiliser Use
title_zh: 迈向循环生物经济的小举措：采纳种养结合系统及其对化肥使用的影响
title_primary: 迈向循环生物经济的小举措：采纳种养结合系统及其对化肥使用的影响
title_secondary: A Small Act Towards Circular Bioeconomy: Adoption of Integrated Crop‐Livestock System and Its Impacts on Fertiliser Use
authors: Hongyun Zheng, Wanglin Ma, Dil Bahadur Rahut, Liangang Zhang, Xiaoshi Zhou
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The integrated crop‐livestock system (ICLS) involves rural households simultaneously engaging in crop cultivation and livestock rearing, embodying the principles of a circular bioeconomy. In this system, crop cultivation produces straw as livestock feed, while livestock rearing generates manure that enriches the soil for crop production. This small‐scale circular model enables farmers to efficiently utilise renewable natural resources, such as crop residues and livestock waste, as sustainable alternatives to non‐renewable, fossil‐based inputs like chemical fertiliser. This paper analyses rice farmers' adoption of ICLS and its impact on fertiliser use using data collected from rural China. This study employs probit two‐stage least squares and the endogenous treatment effect model to address the endogeneity of ICLS adoption. The results indicate that ICLS adoption significantly increases expenditure and application frequency of bio‐fertiliser, while its impact on chemical fertiliser use is insignificant, though negative. The negative effect of ICLS adoption on chemical fertiliser use is only observed among young farmers. ICLS adoption is correlated with an increase in farm revenue. These findings suggest that reducing chemical fertiliser use and increasing bio‐fertiliser use, facilitated by ICLS adoption, do not compromise food security and contribute to the transition towards a circular bioeconomy.
abstract_zh: 农牧结合系统（ICLS）涉及农村家庭同时从事作物种植和牲畜饲养，体现了循环生物经济的原则。在该系统中，作物种植产生的秸秆作为牲畜饲料，而牲畜饲养产生的粪便则肥沃土壤，促进作物生产。这一小规模循环模式使农民能够高效利用可再生自然资源，如作物残留物和牲畜废弃物，作为不可再生、基于化石的投入品（如化肥）的可持续替代品。本文利用中国农村收集的数据，分析了稻农采纳农牧结合系统及其对化肥使用的影响。本研究采用probit两阶段最小二乘法和内生处理效应模型来解决农牧结合系统采纳的内生性问题。结果表明，采纳农牧结合系统显著增加了生物肥料的支出和使用频率，而对化肥使用的影响虽为负但不显著。农牧结合系统采纳对化肥使用的负面效应仅在年轻农民中观察到。农牧结合系统的采纳与农场收入的增加相关。这些发现表明，通过采纳农牧结合系统减少化肥使用和增加生物肥料使用，不会损害粮食安全，并有助于向循环生物经济的转型。

title: Exploring Differences in Precision Agriculture Adoption: New and Beginning Farmers, and Established Farmers
title_zh: 精准农业采纳差异研究：新入行农民、初创农民与资深农民
title_primary: 精准农业采纳差异研究：新入行农民、初创农民与资深农民

authors: Whoi Cho, Oscar Sarasty, Tong Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-03-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper compares precision agriculture (PA) adoption between new and beginning farmers (NBFRs) and established farmers using data from a 2021 U.S. Midwest farmer survey. We focus on the human capital of two different groups of farmers in the PA adoption. NBFRs adopted PA technologies at a higher rate than established farmers, with the most substantial adoption gap observed in diagnostic technologies that require human capital investment. A higher proportion of NBFRs held college degrees in agricultural majors, which significantly influenced PA adoption. The findings highlight the need for targeted education and support to ensure sustainable PA adoption among NBFRs. JEL Classification: Q10, Q12, 116
abstract_zh: 本文利用2021年美国中西部农民调查数据，比较了新型及初创农民（NBFRs）与既有农民在精准农业（PA）技术采纳上的差异。我们聚焦于这两类农民群体在PA采纳过程中的人力资本因素。NBFRs采纳PA技术的比例高于既有农民，其中在需要人力资本投入的诊断技术方面，采纳差距最为显著。NBFRs中持有农业相关专业大学学位的比例更高，这一因素显著影响了PA技术的采纳。研究结果强调了针对NBFRs开展定向教育与支持的必要性，以确保其可持续采纳PA技术。JEL分类号：Q10, Q12, 116

title: Lost in aggregation? On the importance of local food price data for food poverty estimates
title_zh: 迷失在加总中？论本地食品价格数据对食品贫困估算的重要性
title_primary: 迷失在加总中？论本地食品价格数据对食品贫困估算的重要性
title_secondary: Lost in aggregation? On the importance of local food price data for food poverty estimates
authors: Stephan Dietrich, Valerio Giuffrida, Bruno Martorano, Georg Schmerzeck, Marco Tiberti
official: 官方在线 2026-03-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores within‐country variations in food price dynamics and food poverty estimates by employing local market price data and national consumer price index (CPI) data. Our results show that national CPI data may be useful for approximating national trends but they fail to detect and identify spatial variations in local trends, which have relevant welfare implications. Indeed, sourcing cereal prices from local markets, instead of national CPI statistics, leads to classification divergences in 9% of food poverty predictions, with a substantial variation in estimation errors across countries. Our findings thus underscore the need for the systematic collection of local price data to ensure effective policymaking, such as adjusting social transfers to better reflect local differences and optimizing the allocation of social funds.
abstract_zh: 本文通过运用地方市场价格数据与全国居民消费价格指数（CPI）数据，探讨了食品价格动态及食品贫困估计的国内差异。研究结果显示，全国CPI数据虽有助于近似反映全国趋势，但无法捕捉和识别地方趋势中的空间差异，而这些差异对福利具有重要影响。实际上，若从地方市场获取谷物价格而非依赖全国CPI统计，会导致9%的食品贫困预测出现分类偏差，且各国间的估计误差差异显著。因此，我们的研究结果强调了系统收集地方价格数据的必要性，以确保政策制定的有效性，例如调整社会转移支付以更好地反映地方差异，并优化社会资金的分配。

title: Technological progress and the global decline in the manufacturing labour share
title_zh: 技术进步与全球制造业劳动份额的下降
title_primary: 技术进步与全球制造业劳动份额的下降
title_secondary: Technological progress and the global decline in the manufacturing labour share
authors: Jakob B. Madsen, Kesavarajah K. Mayandy
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using manufacturing data for a panel of 86 low- , middle-, and high-income countries over the period 1963–2020, this study investigates the effects of domestic and foreign technological progress on the labour share dynamics in low- and high-tech manufacturing. We find that the increase in domestic and, in particular, foreign technological progress since approximately 1990, has reduced the labour share in high-income countries and contributed to an increase in the labour share in middle- and low-income countries. The positive effects in the low-income countries have been driven by high R&D-intensity firms. Overall, we find that estimates for the US and other high-income countries cannot be used to project the underlying drivers of labour shares in the middle- and low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用1963至2020年间86个低收入、中等收入及高收入国家的制造业面板数据，探讨了国内外技术进步对低技术和高技术制造业劳动份额动态的影响。研究发现，自1990年前后起，国内外技术进步（尤其是国外技术进步）的提升，减少了高收入国家的劳动份额，同时促进了中等收入和低收入国家劳动份额的增长。低收入国家的积极效应主要由高研发密集型企业驱动。总体而言，我们的结果表明，美国及其他高收入国家的估计结果不能用于预测中等收入和低收入国家劳动份额的根本驱动因素。

title: The Dynamic Effects of Health on the Employment of Older Workers: Impacts by Gender, Country, and Race

abstract: Using data from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA), we estimate the impact of health on employment for individuals close to retirement age. Estimating the model separately by race and gender, we find that racial differences in employment can be partly explained by the worse health of minorities as well as the larger impact of health on employment for minorities.
abstract_zh: 利用健康与退休研究（HRS）和英国老龄化纵向研究（ELSA）的数据，我们估算了健康状况对临近退休年龄个体就业的影响。通过按种族和性别分别估计模型，我们发现种族间的就业差异可部分归因于少数族裔较差的健康状况，以及健康状况对少数族裔就业产生的更大影响。

title_secondary: Can interactions between companies and minority investors improve the ESG performance? Insights from interactive investor platforms
authors: Ziyao Xu, Yang Gao, Zhiqiang Du, Junfeng Ma
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As the global attention to corporate sustainability and social responsibility continues to grow, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) has emerged as significant criteria for evaluating the comprehensive performance of enterprises. However, there is limited literature to investigate ESG performance from the perspective of minority investors. Utilizing the ‘Hudongyi’ and ‘Ehudong’ platforms, this study investigates the impact of ESG interactions between companies and minority investors on corporate ESG performance among listed companies from 2010 to 2022. Our findings reveal that ESG interactions can significantly enhance corporate ESG performance, with alleviating information asymmetry and increasing external supervision as potential channels. Further, a heterogeneous analysis conducted through the environmental (E), social (S), and governance (G) indicates that this positive relationship is especially pronounced among companies with heavy-polluting, state-owned and poor internal control. The results highlight the pivotal role of minority investors in driving companies to improve their ESG performance and have important implications for promoting corporate greater participation in ESG activities.

title: DSR and Household debt delinquency: evidence from South Korea
title_zh: DSR与家庭债务违约：来自韩国的证据
title_primary: DSR与家庭债务违约：来自韩国的证据
title_secondary: DSR and Household debt delinquency: evidence from South Korea
authors: Dong-Jin Pyo
official: 官方在线 2025-08-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the debt service ratio (DSR) as a predictor of household financial distress in South Korea, with a particular focus on identifying the threshold at which delinquency risk rises sharply. Leveraging household-level microdata and a multilevel Bayesian threshold regression model, we estimate the tipping point in the DSR – default relationship while accounting for household heterogeneity. Our findings indicate that the critical DSR threshold falls below current regulatory benchmarks, suggesting that many households may experience financial strain at lower debt levels than anticipated by policymakers. Notably, we find substantial variation by employment type: temporary and self-employed workers exhibit significantly higher vulnerability, even at moderate DSRs. These results highlight the limitations of uniform regulatory caps and support the need for differentiated, evidence-based lending standards. By offering the first data-driven estimate of DSR thresholds in Korea, this study advances the academic understanding of household credit risk and informs ongoing macroprudential policy development. KEYWORDS: Debt service ratio Delinquency financial stability multilevel bayesian model JEL CLASSIFICATION: G51 C11 D14 G21
abstract_zh: 本研究以韩国为对象，考察偿债比率（DSR）作为家庭财务困境预测指标的有效性，重点识别违约风险急剧上升的阈值。通过运用家庭层面微观数据与多层贝叶斯阈值回归模型，我们在考虑家庭异质性的基础上，估算了DSR与违约关系中的临界点。研究结果表明，关键DSR阈值低于现行监管基准，这意味着许多家庭在债务水平低于政策制定者预期时便可能面临财务压力。值得注意的是，不同就业类型之间存在显著差异：临时工与自雇劳动者即使在中等DSR水平下也表现出明显更高的脆弱性。这些结果揭示了统一监管上限的局限性，并支持制定差异化、基于证据的贷款标准。通过首次提供韩国DSR阈值的数据驱动估计，本研究深化了对家庭信用风险的学术理解，并为当前宏观审慎政策的发展提供参考。关键词：偿债比率；违约；金融稳定；多层贝叶斯模型 JEL分类：G51；C11；D14；G21

title: Do We Choose Differently after a Discussion? Results from a Deliberative Valuation Study in Ireland
title_zh: 讨论后我们的选择会不同吗？来自爱尔兰一项审议估值研究的结果
title_primary: 讨论后我们的选择会不同吗？来自爱尔兰一项审议估值研究的结果
title_secondary: Do We Choose Differently after a Discussion? Results from a Deliberative Valuation Study in Ireland
authors: Aanesen, M., Armstrong, C. W., Rensburg, T. V.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A criticism against individual-based stated preference surveys is that people seldom make choices in social isolation. An approach used in response to this is deliberative valuation. We conduct a series of valuation workshops including a choice experiment. This involves providing respondents with information and opportunity to discuss. They made their choices individually both before and after the discussion. On average respondents stated different preferences after the discussion compared to before, and the stated preferences became more consistent after deliberation. Unexpectedly, persons stating high certainty of pre-deliberation choices changed stated preferences more after deliberation than persons stating lower certainty of choices. JEL Q51Q57
abstract_zh: 针对基于个体的陈述偏好调查，一个批评是人们在做出选择时很少处于社会孤立状态。为应对此问题，一种方法是审议式评估。我们开展了一系列评估工作坊，其中包括一项选择实验。这涉及向受访者提供信息并给予讨论机会。他们在讨论前后分别独立做出选择。平均而言，受访者在讨论后陈述的偏好与讨论前相比有所不同，且审议后陈述的偏好变得更加一致。出乎意料的是，在审议前选择中表示高度确定性的个体，在审议后改变陈述偏好的程度大于表示较低确定性的个体。JEL分类号：Q51 Q57
